topic: Telling {健太|けんた} about レン
context: Tuesday 1 December, a quiet evening at {ゲストハウス風|ゲストハウスかぜ}: {健太|けんた} catches アルちゃん smiling at his phone, and アルちゃん tells him for the first time about レン, the man he met on the app.
scene: Quiet Tuesday evening at reception. {健太|けんた} catches you grinning at your phone and wants to know who it is.

phrases.jp: {優しそう|やさしそう}な{人|ひと}だね。
phrases.note: い-adj stem + そう = looks… From a photo or first meeting.

phrases.jp: {彼|かれ}は{長野市|ながのし}でデザイナーとして{働いて|はたらいて|to work|4}います。
phrases.en: He works as a designer in {長野市|ながのし}.
phrases.note: Job + として{働|はたら}く = work as.

phrases.jp: {見た目|みため|looks, appearance|4}より、{性格|せいかく|personality|4}が{大事|だいじ}。
phrases.note: AよりBが{大事|だいじ} = B matters more than A.

phrases.jp: {笑顔|えがお|smile|4}がすてきな{人|ひと}。
phrases.note: A classic compliment, also on dating profiles.

phrases.jp: コーヒーにでも{誘って|さそって|to invite, ask out|4}みようかな。
phrases.en: Maybe I'll ask him out for a coffee or something.
phrases.note: 〜にでも = '…or something', makes the invitation light.

dialogue_setting: {ゲストハウス風|ゲストハウスかぜ} reception, Tuesday evening. No guests are checking in; the stove is on.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: アルちゃん、さっきからスマホ{見て|みて}{ニヤニヤ||grinning|3}してるやん。{誰|だれ}なん？
dialogue.en: アルちゃん, you've been grinning at your phone for ages. Who is it?
dialogue.note: Kansai: やん = じゃない, なん = なの.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: …アプリで{知り合った|しりあった|to get to know, meet|3}{人|ひと}。{長野市|ながのし}でデザイナーとして{働いて|はたらいて|to work|4}る、レンさんっていう{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}。
dialogue.en: …Someone I met on the app. A guy called レン who works as a designer in {長野市|ながのし}.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: へえ、ええやん！どんな{人|ひと}？{写真|しゃしん}{見せて|みせて}や。
dialogue.en: Oh, nice! What's he like? Show me a photo.
dialogue.note: Kansai: ええ = いい, {見|み}せてや = {見|み}せてよ.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {落ち着いて|おちついて}て、ちょっと{人見知り|ひとみしり|shy with strangers|3}。でも{映画|えいが}の{話|はなし}になると、{目|め}が{キラキラ||sparkling|3}するんだ。
dialogue.en: He's calm and a bit shy. But when we talk about films, his eyes light up.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: ほんで、{友達|ともだち}として？それとも{恋人|こいびと}{候補|こうほ|candidate|3}として？
dialogue.en: So, as a friend? Or as a possible boyfriend?
dialogue.note: Kansai: ほんで = それで.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: まだ{会った|あった}こともないよ！…でも、{正直|しょうじき}{会って|あって}みたい。
dialogue.en: We haven't even met yet! …But honestly, I'd like to meet him.

listening.intro: {健太|けんた} grins and gives you one piece of advice.

lines.jp: コーヒーにでも{誘って|さそって}みたら？{応援|おうえん|support, cheering on|3}してるで。
lines.en: Why not ask him for a coffee? I'm rooting for you.
lines.note: Kansai: してるで = してるよ.

grammar.form: noun + として (デザイナーとして, {友達|ともだち}として) · before a noun: noun + としての + noun ({親|おや}としての{気持|きも}ち)
grammar.explanation: Gives the role or capacity something is in: as a designer, as a friend. With a job, として{働|はたら}く is the natural pair. Don't confuse it with にとって, which is a point of view ('for me').

examples.jp: {姉|あね}は{看護師|かんごし|nurse|3}として{病院|びょういん}で{働いて|はたらいて}いる。
examples.en: My sister works as a nurse at a hospital.

examples.jp: {親|おや|parent|3}としての{気持ち|きもち}、{今|いま}なら{分かる|わかる}。
examples.en: Now I understand how it feels as a parent.

quiz.question: {彼|かれ}は{留学生|りゅうがくせい|exchange student|3}＿＿{日本|にほん}に{来ました|きました}。
quiz.en: He came to Japan as an exchange student.
quiz.explain: His role when he came → として.

quiz_more.question: {先生|せんせい}＿＿{仕事|しごと}は、{大変|たいへん}だけど{楽しい|たのしい}。
quiz_more.en: The work as a teacher is hard but fun.
quiz_more.explain: Before a noun ({仕事|しごと}) use としての.

quiz_more.question: {私|わたし}＿＿、この{町|まち}は{第二|だいに}のふるさとです。
quiz_more.en: For me, this town is a second home.
quiz_more.explain: From my point of view → にとって. として would make 'I' a role.

kanji.where: On レン's profile in the dating app: 「相性 92%」.
kanji.breakdown: {相性|あいしょう}: 相 mutual, each other + 性 nature → 'how two natures fit together'.
kanji.related: {相性|あいしょう}がいい = we get on well. Also for food and wine, or a player and a team.

tip.title: Out to some, not to all
tip.body: Many gay people in Japan are out only to close friends, like レン. Neutral words like {恋人|こいびと} or パートナー are common. If someone tells you, don't pass it on unless they say it's OK: telling others is called アウティング and is taken seriously.

challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた}: 「{練習|れんしゅう}しとき！レンさんに『{日本|にほん}で{何|なに}してるの？』って{聞かれたら|きかれたら}？」 Answer that you came as a volunteer and help on a farm and at a school.
challenge.model_answer: ボランティアとして{来て|きて}、{農家|のうか|farm, farming family|3}と{学校|がっこう}で{手伝って|てつだって}るよ。
challenge.explanation: ボランティアとして gives your role in Japan. {来|き}て links it to what you do there, {手伝|てつだ}ってる. Plain form + よ suits a chat with レン, who already talks casually with you.

vocab.note: A secret, slightly silly grin. ニコニコ is a friendly smile.
How you met someone: {大学|だいがく}で{知|し}り{合|あ}った. {知|し}り{合|あ}い = acquaintance.
〜として{働|はたら}く = work as. {仕事|しごと}する is more casual.
Stars, snow, or eyes full of excitement.
Elections, job lists, or teasing: {恋人|こいびと}{候補|こうほ}.
Literally 'how it looks to the eye'. Also for food.
{性格|せいかく}がいい = good-natured. {明|あか}るい{性格|せいかく} = cheerful.
{笑|え} laugh + {顔|がお} face. A smiling face, not the act of smiling.
{食事|しょくじ}に{誘|さそ}う = ask someone to dinner. Both friends and dates.

kanji_study.parts: 人 a lid on top + 一 + 口 a pot → a lid that fits its pot: fit, match, meet.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 会 (meet): 会 has 云 under the roof, 合 has 一 and 口.

kanji_study.parts: 言 words radical + 秀 excellent → using your best words to get someone to come: invite.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 透 (transparent): both have 秀, but 透 has 辶 road, 誘 has 言 words.

extras.title: Describing someone's character
extras.title_jp: {性格|せいかく}を{表す|あらわす}{言葉|ことば}
extras.intro: Words for what someone is like.

items.note: A compliment in Japan, sometimes 'a bit too serious'.
The top quality people list for a partner.
Someone who says what they feel and listens.

items.en: does things at their own pace
items.note: Japanese-made English. Neutral or gently teasing.

extras.title: Words for a partner
extras.title_jp: {恋人|こいびと}の{呼び方|よびかた}
extras.intro: How people refer to someone they're dating.

items.note: {彼女|かのじょ} = girlfriend. The everyday words.
Neutral; used more and more, also by gay couples.
